title: Amazing experience
text: Amazing opportunity to reconnect with yourself. The whole yoga session was a positive transformation for the body and your inner spirit- gratitude to Augustina you are amazing. The sailing experience enjoyed a lot, since there is no better place to enjoy the sea and sun and meanwhile to be so relaxed and free-spirited. It was an amazing experience that i have to repeat several times for sure. Thanks for everybody who organize this event it is life changing!
author: Adventurer535113

title: Unique
text:
Unique experience 🙏

See you next time x
author: T9155UPelenal

title: Relaxing and beautiful
text: I had such a lovely time, the boat was the perfect size for the 6 guests. The yoga teacher did a nice relaxing class using the boat as a prop. After the class we were able to jump into the ocean and swim with the jelly fish. Once back to shore we ate an amazing vegan brunch. I left calm and relaxed. I would definitely go again and recommend it to other people coming to barcelona.
author: heatheraY2089JQ

title: An Enchanting Journey to Spiritual Bliss 🌿⛵
text: This sailing and yoga adventure effortlessly connects you with nature's serenity, while the positivity and radiant energy of the people onboard add a vibrant dimension to the experience. A short yoga session, followed by a tranquil 2-hour sail along the stunning coastline, creates a spiritual bond with the elements. Anchoring in a peaceful spot, you'll find inner peace. An adventure not to be missed for those seeking a deep connection with nature and the wonderful souls who accompany you." 🧘‍♂️🌅🌊🌟🙌🌞
author: gabrielalazova

title: My favourite experience
text: My friends surprised me for my birthday with this awesome yoga and sailing daily retreat. I loved it! I love Sailing and I practice yoga, but I never tried this combination of both together! Augus was the appropriate person ( a real mermaid) that helped us connect with the Sea and made everything so harmonic. Definitely recommend!
author: cankav2023

title: Wow experience!
text: Barcelona from other point of view. Beautiful sailig. Our host Augustina gave us exelent yoga jorney. Complete relax. Also her vegan meals prepearad with a lot of love completly filled the joy of this trip. Go for relax.
author: 921aleksandard

title: Best experience

author: 229rebekas

title: Ready for a transformative journey? This is IT!
text: This was an amazing experience! Such a transformative journey full of magic & bliss. I enjoyed & connected with the Sea like never before. The yoga session was perfectly adapted to all of us there &  Augustina guided us through an incredible meditation that melted my heart. She cooked delicious Vegan food for us & we had such a great time with the group. Fransesc our captain, overtook the sails & took us on a strategic spot where you can contemplate Barcelona with its splendid views. No doubt, this is something you should definitely try!  Big Thanks to them🙏
author: Lamaredelmar
